Mechanical because solenoid coils draw about 39-59 mA at 230 V (the coil marking's 9-13.5 VA, connector-pinouts.md) against a BTA16's 60 mA holding current, so a triac cannot latch on them; contacts also fail open on power loss (D5, D6). Two separate I2C buses, so both units can stay at the fixed 0x7F address (no mux; the address is also programmable in EEPROM, to be confirmed with the seller). Per h743-pin-allocation.csv: I2C1, AF4, verified against DS12110 Table 10 Port B

0.5MPa (5 bar) range - deliberately matched to the steam OPV on the pump (about 4-5 bar per the owner; read the setting off the part), which is the pressure ceiling only if no check valve lies between it and the block (to be inspected); otherwise the block is bounded by the 200C thermostat (about 15.5 bar absolute, about 17 bar absolute at the thermostat tolerance). Gives ~0.05 bar/count at +/-1% FS vs ~0.12 bar on a 1.2MPa unit. Survives a 5.5 bar pump deadhead (a JYPC-family figure, not established for the fitted pump) on its 150% FS (7.5 bar gauge) overload rating; it clips rather than breaks, and clipping is acceptable if the OPV is acting at that point (if it does not cap the block, the block can reach the thermostat-bound pressure, above this sensor's 7.5 bar gauge overload and, at the thermostat tolerance, its 15 bar gauge burst)
Second, separate I2C bus - same reasoning as #1. Per h743-pin-allocation.csv: I2C2, AF4, verified against DS12110 Table 10 Port B

Required because the EARU SSR-40DA needs 7.5-12mA at 3-32VDC and a 3V3 GPIO cannot supply that reliably. About 24mA total: the SSR control current (2 x up to 12mA) drawn from the 5V rail through the ULN2003A, not a GPIO current; the 5V budget carries 29mA for it (see the power architecture row). Each input also carries a 10k pull-down to GND (SAFETY-CRITICAL, fitted at the breakout board's header, so it holds if the cable comes off). Unused IN3-IN7 to GND. Per h743-pin-allocation.csv: TIM3_CH3/CH4-capable, AF2, verified against DS12110 Table 10 Port B; used as plain GPIO

Open-collector sink of about 12mA each. The Darlington drops about 1V so each SSR sees about 4V, above its 3V minimum - measure it. Run as an LV loom, separate from mains (REQ-ELECTRICAL-INSTALL-001.C1)
